symptom: env-misconfig flags test-infrastructure env keys (playwright configs, e2e harnesses, capture scripts) as missing from .env.example. The rule's remediation — 'a fresh deploy fails' — does not apply to test-only keys that already carry ?? defaults.
evidence: evalforge: EVALFORGE_TEST_PYTHON, EVALFORGE_LIVE_API_PORT, EVALFORGE_API_ONLY, EVALFORGE_USE_STATIC_BUILD, NEXT_DIST_DIR flagged from playwright.config/e2e files; policydesk: POLICYDESK_TEST_PYTHON, POLICYDESK_PREVIEW_URL flagged from playwright.server.config.ts and scripts/capture-proof.mjs.
root_cause: The rule walks every source file without distinguishing product code from test tooling, and flags every undeclared key regardless of whether it already has a safe default.
notes: Same discovery pass as deploy-misconfig-env-backed-fp. Genuine product-code keys (e.g. NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL) must still be flagged.
